title: Anthropic expected to receive high 'junk' rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says | TechCrunch
summary: The FT says the investment giant Blackstone, the anchor investor in a recent $63 billion deal to finance Anthropic’s chips, told investors in the deal that it expects the AI lab to receive a “high” junk rating after its IPO.
